input.content: Pattern: premature removal of a dual-read compatibility path while a background data migration is still in progress. A "cleanup" that drops the legacy-shape branch from a reader (e.g. address_of only reading row["destination"]["address"]) breaks every caller listing unmigrated rows (KeyError, so the whole list request fails) when migration runs in bounded batches with no completion gate. Before approving reader simplification, check: (1) the README/contract says reads must handle both shapes until migration finishes, (2) is there a gate or evidence that migration is done (zero legacy rows in every environment)? (3) do the tests cover a legacy row? Suites that only test new writes pass even though legacy reads are broken. Remove the legacy read only after migration completion has been verified, in its own step.
